job.question: In the Los Angeles City Employees' Retirement System (LACERS) actuarial RFP, how many years of experience must the lead actuary have?
job.expected_facts: At least 15 years of experience with major public employee retirement systems, including at least 3 years with California public pension fund clients similar to LACERS.
job.acceptance: Accept 15 total and three California years. Do not require credential details unrelated to the years asked.

reviews.reason: This is a South Carolina RSIC investment consulting RFP, not a LACERS actuarial RFP. Its experience requirement concerns lead investment consultants and does not support the specified lead-actuary requirement.
quotes: South Carolina Retirement System Investment Commission General Investment Consulting Services RFP

The individual(s) assigned to RSIC as lead consultant(s) must have a minimum of ten (10) years of experience (each) with a public defined benefit plan and at least five (5) years’ experience (each) as a primary consultant for a public defined benefit plan.
